question: What year has been declared as the International Year of the Woman Farmer?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**2026**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Empowering women in agriculture for food security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**2026** is declared as the **International Year of the Woman Farmer**.

 
 
• 
 
The declaration was made by the **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)**.

 
 
• 
 
Supported by over **100 co-sponsoring countries**.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to **recognise women's role in agriculture** and raise awareness about their challenges.

 
 
• 
 
Women face barriers such as **limited property rights** and **restricted market access**.

 
 
• 
 
It promotes **resilient agricultural development** and **gender equality**.

 
 
• 
 
Aims to ensure **food security** through women’s empowerment in agriculture.
